SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0483')
             / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH primary_sub AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS first_submission
  FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY 1, 2
),
paid AS (
  SELECT r.payer_class, date_diff('day', s.first_submission, r.payment_date) AS days_to_pay
  FROM sem.remit_claims r JOIN primary_sub s USING (claim_key, payer_key)
  WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.paid_amount > 0
)
SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS paid_claims,
       round(median(days_to_pay), 1) AS median_days,
       round(quantile_cont(days_to_pay, 0.9), 1) AS p90_days
FROM paid GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT a.carc_code, count(DISTINCT a.claim_key || '|' || a.payer_key) AS denied_claims
FROM sem.adjustments a
JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.remit_claim_id = a.remit_claim_id
WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied AND a.group_code = 'CO' AND a.is_denial_carc
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 5

WITH ev AS (
  SELECT payer_class, claim_key, payer_key, count(*) AS n_events,
         bool_or(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied) AS current_not_denied
  FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS remitted_pairs,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE n_events = 1 AND current_not_denied) AS first_pass_resolved,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE n_events = 1 AND current_not_denied) / count(*), 2) AS first_pass_rate_pct
FROM ev GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT payer_class, claim_key, payer_key,
         count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) AS n_traces,
         bool_or(is_reversal) AS has_reversal,
         bool_or(is_current_adjudication) AS has_current,
         sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication) AS current_paid
  FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  HAVING count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) >= 2
)
SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS multi_trace_pairs,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_reversal) AS pairs_with_reversal,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_current) AS pairs_with_no_current,
       round(coalesce(sum(current_paid), 0), 2) AS current_paid
FROM pairs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS partial_denied_lines
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied

WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P')
SELECT coalesce(round(sum(a.adjustment_amount), 2), 0) AS deductible
FROM sem.adjustments a JOIN p USING (claim_key, payer_key)
WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code = 'PR' AND a.carc_code = '1'

WITH base AS (
  SELECT service_month, referring_npi, count(*) AS n
  FROM sem.claims
  WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_month >= DATE '2026-06-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT service_month, n,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY service_month ORDER BY n DESC, referring_npi) AS rk,
         sum(n) OVER (PARTITION BY service_month) AS total_claims
  FROM base
)
SELECT service_month, max(total_claims) AS total_claims,
       sum(n) FILTER (WHERE rk <= 5) AS top5_claims,
       round(100.0 * sum(n) FILTER (WHERE rk <= 5) / max(total_claims), 1) AS top5_share_pct
FROM ranked GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '87798')
             / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH billed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT procedure_code, claim_key, payer_key
  FROM sem.claim_lines WHERE is_latest_submission
)
SELECT b.procedure_code, round(avg(r.is_denied::INT), 4) AS denial_rate
FROM billed b
JOIN sem.remit_claims r
  ON r.claim_key = b.claim_key AND r.payer_key = b.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication
GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 20 ORDER BY 1

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, charge_amount,
         CASE WHEN line_count >= 3 THEN '3+' ELSE cast(line_count AS VARCHAR) END AS bucket
  FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND payer_responsibility = 'P'
)
SELECT l.bucket, count(*) AS claims,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.is_denied) AS denied_claims,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.is_denied) / count(*), 2) AS denial_rate_pct,
       round(coalesce(sum(l.charge_amount) FILTER (WHERE r.is_denied), 0), 2) AS denied_billed_charge
FROM latest l
JOIN sem.remit_claims r
  ON r.claim_key = l.claim_key AND r.payer_key = l.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH fb AS (
  SELECT payer_key, reference_id, payment_date, provider_adjustment_amount
  FROM sem.provider_adjustments WHERE plb_reason_code = 'FB'
)
SELECT c.reference_id, c.payment_date AS carried_forward_on,
       round(-c.provider_adjustment_amount, 2) AS amount_carried_forward,
       o.payment_date AS offset_on,
       date_diff('day', c.payment_date, o.payment_date) AS days_between
FROM fb c
LEFT JOIN fb o
  ON o.payer_key = c.payer_key AND o.reference_id = c.reference_id
 AND o.provider_adjustment_amount = -c.provider_adjustment_amount
 AND o.payment_date > c.payment_date
 AND NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM fb o2
   WHERE o2.payer_key = c.payer_key AND o2.reference_id = c.reference_id
     AND o2.provider_adjustment_amount = -c.provider_adjustment_amount
     AND o2.payment_date > c.payment_date AND o2.payment_date < o.payment_date)
WHERE c.provider_adjustment_amount < 0
ORDER BY c.payment_date, c.reference_id

WITH m AS (
  SELECT payer_class, payment_month, sum(paid_amount) AS paid
  FROM sem.remit_claims
  WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payment_month IN (DATE '2026-07-01', DATE '2026-08-01')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
tot AS (SELECT payment_month, sum(paid) AS month_total FROM m GROUP BY 1),
cls AS (SELECT DISTINCT payer_class FROM m)
SELECT c.payer_class,
       round(100.0 * jul.paid / nullif(jul_tot.month_total, 0), 1) AS july_share_pct,
       round(100.0 * aug.paid / nullif(aug_tot.month_total, 0), 1) AS august_share_pct,
       round(100.0 * aug.paid / nullif(aug_tot.month_total, 0)
             - 100.0 * jul.paid / nullif(jul_tot.month_total, 0), 1) AS change_pp
FROM cls c
LEFT JOIN m jul ON jul.payer_class = c.payer_class AND jul.payment_month = DATE '2026-07-01'
LEFT JOIN m aug ON aug.payer_class = c.payer_class AND aug.payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01'
LEFT JOIN tot jul_tot ON jul_tot.payment_month = DATE '2026-07-01'
LEFT JOIN tot aug_tot ON aug_tot.payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01'
ORDER BY 1

WITH orig AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS orig_date
  FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' AND frequency_code = '1' GROUP BY 1, 2
),
repl AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS repl_date
  FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' AND frequency_code = '7' GROUP BY 1, 2
),
cur AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, payment_date, paid_amount
  FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication
)
SELECT count(*) AS corrected_claims,
       round(avg(r.repl_date - o.orig_date), 2) AS avg_days_to_replacement,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.payment_date >= r.repl_date) AS adjudicated_after_replacement,
       round(avg(c.payment_date - o.orig_date) FILTER (WHERE c.payment_date >= r.repl_date), 2) AS avg_days_to_payment,
       round(coalesce(sum(c.paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE c.payment_date >= r.repl_date), 0), 2) AS total_paid
FROM repl r
LEFT JOIN orig o USING (claim_key, payer_key)
LEFT JOIN cur c USING (claim_key, payer_key)

WITH voids AS (
  SELECT claim_key, min(submission_date) AS void_date
  FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '8' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT count(*) AS voided_claims,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r
         WHERE r.claim_key = v.claim_key AND r.paid_amount > 0 AND r.payment_date < v.void_date
       )) AS paid_before_void,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r
         WHERE r.claim_key = v.claim_key AND r.is_reversal AND r.payment_date >= v.void_date
       )) AS reversed_on_or_after_void,
       round(coalesce(sum((
         SELECT sum(r.paid_amount) FROM sem.remit_claims r
         WHERE r.claim_key = v.claim_key AND r.is_current_adjudication
       )), 0), 2) AS current_paid
FROM voids v

SELECT count(*) AS zero_paid_not_denied
FROM sem.remit_claims
WHERE is_current_adjudication AND paid_amount = 0 AND NOT is_denied

WITH repl AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(payer_class) AS payer_class, min(submission_date) AS repl_date
  FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '7' GROUP BY 1, 2
),
first_remit AS (
  SELECT r.claim_key, r.payer_key, min(r.payment_date) AS first_date
  FROM sem.remit_claims r JOIN repl p USING (claim_key, payer_key)
  WHERE r.payment_date >= p.repl_date GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT p.payer_class, count(*) AS corrected_claims,
       round(avg(f.first_date - p.repl_date), 1) AS avg_days,
       min(f.first_date - p.repl_date) AS min_days,
       max(f.first_date - p.repl_date) AS max_days
FROM repl p JOIN first_remit f USING (claim_key, payer_key)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS reversed_without_current FROM (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  HAVING bool_or(is_reversal) AND NOT bool_or(is_current_adjudication)
) s

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '80307')
             / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH first_sub AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(payer_class) AS payer_class, min(submission_date) AS first_date
  FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  HAVING min(submission_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31'
),
first_remit AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(payment_date) AS first_pay
  FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT s.payer_class, count(*) AS cohort_claims,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.first_pay - s.first_date <= 14) AS remitted_within_14,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.first_pay - s.first_date <= 14) / count(*), 1) AS share_pct
FROM first_sub s LEFT JOIN first_remit f USING (claim_key, payer_key)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0482')
             / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH repl AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS repl_date
  FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '7' GROUP BY 1, 2
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT r.claim_key, r.payer_key, r.repl_date FROM repl r
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims d
    WHERE d.claim_key = r.claim_key AND d.payer_key = r.payer_key
      AND d.claim_status_code = '4' AND d.payment_date < r.repl_date)
),
later AS (
  SELECT e.*, EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims x
    WHERE x.claim_key = e.claim_key AND x.payer_key = e.payer_key AND x.payment_date >= e.repl_date
  ) AS has_later FROM eligible e
),
cur AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, is_denied, paid_amount
  FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT l.has_later THEN 'no remit since correction'
              WHEN c.claim_key IS NOT NULL AND NOT c.is_denied THEN 'overturned'
              ELSE 'denied again' END AS outcome,
         coalesce(c.paid_amount, 0) AS current_paid
  FROM later l LEFT JOIN cur c USING (claim_key, payer_key)
)
SELECT outcome, count(*) AS claims, round(coalesce(sum(current_paid), 0), 2) AS current_paid
FROM labeled GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH earlier AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims
  WHERE adjudication_state = 'superseded' AND NOT is_reversal AND is_denied
),
cur AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims
  WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied
)
SELECT count(*) AS overturned_pairs, round(coalesce(sum(c.paid_amount), 0), 2) AS current_paid
FROM cur c JOIN earlier e USING (claim_key, payer_key)

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, charge_amount FROM sem.claims
  WHERE is_latest_submission AND payer_responsibility = 'P' AND frequency_code <> '8'
),
first_sub AS (
  SELECT claim_key, payer_key, min(submission_date) AS first_date
  FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY 1, 2
),
open_ar AS (
  SELECT date_diff('day', f.first_date, DATE '2026-08-14') AS age, l.charge_amount
  FROM latest l JOIN first_sub f USING (claim_key, payer_key)
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r
    WHERE r.claim_key = l.claim_key AND r.payer_key = l.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication)
)
SELECT CASE WHEN age <= 14 THEN '0-14' WHEN age <= 29 THEN '15-29' ELSE '30+' END AS bucket,
       count(*) AS claims, round(sum(charge_amount), 2) AS billed_charge
FROM open_ar GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(age)

SELECT count(*) AS never_remitted
FROM (
  SELECT claim_key, min(submission_date) AS first_submission, bool_or(has_remit) AS has_remit
  FROM sem.claims GROUP BY 1
) s
WHERE date_trunc('month', first_submission) = DATE '2026-07-01' AND NOT has_remit

WITH lines AS (
  SELECT payer_name, payer_key, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount
  FROM sem.remit_lines
  WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied
    AND units_paid = 1 AND line_allowed_amount > 0
),
freq AS (
  SELECT payer_key, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount AS typical, count(*) AS n
  FROM lines GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
typical AS (
  SELECT payer_key, procedure_code, typical FROM freq
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY payer_key, procedure_code ORDER BY n DESC, typical DESC) = 1
)
SELECT l.payer_name AS payer,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.line_allowed_amount < t.typical) AS underpaid_lines,
       round(coalesce(sum(t.typical - l.line_allowed_amount)
                      FILTER (WHERE l.line_allowed_amount < t.typical), 0), 2) AS shortfall
FROM lines l JOIN typical t USING (payer_key, procedure_code)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY shortfall DESC, payer

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0480')
             / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH m AS (
  SELECT payer_class, payment_month, count(*) AS n,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied
  FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT payer_class, strftime(payment_month, '%Y-%m') AS month,
       n AS current_adjudications, denied,
       round(100.0 * denied / n, 2) AS denial_rate_pct,
       round(100.0 * (denied * 1.0 / n - lag(denied * 1.0 / n)
             OVER (PARTITION BY payer_class ORDER BY payment_month)), 2) AS mom_change_pp
FROM m ORDER BY payer_class, payment_month

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '81479')
             / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share
FROM sem.remit_lines
WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key, referring_npi
  FROM sem.claims
  WHERE is_latest_submission AND payer_responsibility = 'P' AND referring_npi IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT l.referring_npi, round(avg(r.is_denied::INT), 4) AS denial_rate
FROM latest l
JOIN sem.remit_claims r
  ON r.claim_key = l.claim_key AND r.payer_key = l.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication
GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 15
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 5
